newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanese Banque Audi up in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Lebanese Banque Audi up in active trade.

text.p: Shares of Banque Audi rose to $15.5 on their second day of trading on Tuesday from $15 on sharply increased turnover on the Beirut Stock Exchange (BSE).

Turnover in the bank's shares rose to 100,000 shares from 10,000 on Monday. One block trade of 3,000 shares changed hands on the floor at $15.785 and three blocks totalling 201,380 shares traded outside the floor at $15.
Audi, the second Lebanese commercial bank to list on the BSE, offered all its 4,158,000 C shares -- or 30 percent of its total number of shares -- for trading on the market on Monday.
